flowTemplates.dialogTitle: How do you want to start?
flowTemplates.dialogDescription: Pick a ready-made template to edit or start from scratch.

fromScratch.name: Start from scratch
fromScratch.description: Blank canvas. Drag the steps you want.

commentToDm.name: Reply to a comment and DM a link
commentToDm.description: When someone comments a keyword on your post, Mushu replies publicly and sends them a DM with a link.

defaults.replyMessage: Just sent it to your DM! 📩
defaults.dmMessage: Here's the link you asked for: https://example.com

leadFromDm.name: Capture a lead via DM
leadFromDm.description: When someone DMs asking about price, Mushu replies asking for the info you need.

defaults.dmMessage: Great! To send you the price I need to know: are you an individual or a company?

welcomeDm.name: Welcome new DMs
welcomeDm.description: When someone sends you a greeting via DM, Mushu replies with a welcome message.

defaults.dmMessage: Hi! 👋 I'm Mushu, your support agent. How can I help?

palette.title: Available steps
palette.hint: Drag a step onto the canvas to add it. Connect steps by dragging from the bottom dot to the next step's top dot.

inspector.selectBlock: Select a block to edit its settings.

fields.fallbackText: Message if the answer is invalid

placeholders.questionText: What's your email so I can send you the material?
placeholders.fallbackText: I didn't catch that. Can you send it again?

inspector.conditionV2: Condition editor is still being built. For now, this step always takes the first path.
inspector.variableHint: Use {example} in later messages to reuse what the person answered.

comment_keyword.title: When someone comments on your post

nodes.stopExecution: Ends this branch of the automation.

emptyCanvas.title: Start by dragging a trigger from the left
emptyCanvas.body: Pick a step from the left column and drop it on the canvas to begin.

publishErrors.noTrigger: Add at least one trigger (a "When…" step) before publishing.
publishErrors.noAction: Add at least one action (Send a private message or Reply to comment) before publishing.
publishErrors.triggerWithoutKeywords: There's a trigger with no keywords. Click the step and fill in the words that should fire the automation.
publishErrors.actionWithoutText: There's an action with an empty message. Click the step and write what to send.
publishErrors.askQuestionIncomplete: There's an "Ask" step missing the question or the variable name. Click it and fill both.
publishErrors.triggerHasNoPath: There's a trigger that goes nowhere. Connect it to an action by dragging from its bottom dot to the next step.

condition.emptyHint: This step decides which path to follow based on saved variables or contact tags.
condition.explainer: Paths are evaluated in order. The first one that matches is taken. The last path is the default ("else").
condition.lastBranchIsDefault: The last path is taken when nothing else matches.

keywordsInput.hint: Type a word and hit Enter (or comma) to add it.

templateBanner.title: This flow was started from the "{template}" template. Customize everything!
templateBanner.tip1: Click any step to edit keywords, messages or the target post in the right panel.
templateBanner.tip2: Drag new steps from the left column to add more actions (e.g. "Wait before the next step").
templateBanner.tip3: To remove a step, click it and hit the "Delete step" button.
templateBanner.tip4: When you're ready, hit "Publish" in the top-right corner.
